      • CustomerProfile

        public CustomerProfile​(CharSequence customerId,
                       Long profileTimestamp,
                       Double averageTransactionAmount,

        Parameters:
        customerId - Unique customer identifier
        profileTimestamp - Profile last update timestamp
        averageTransactionAmount - Average transaction amount
        typicalTransactionHours - Typical hours when customer transacts
        frequentMerchants - List of frequently used merchant IDs
        homeLocation - Customer's home location
        transactionVelocity1h - Typical transaction velocity per hour
        transactionVelocity24h - Typical transaction velocity per day
        preferredCategories - Preferred merchant categories
        riskScore - Overall customer risk score
